newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Santista still attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santista still attractive.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns & Co said it is reiterating its attractive rating for food firm Santista Alimentos S.A.
-- The brokerage cited the company's strong nine-month earnings of $0.10 per share, making it likely the firm will meet the brokerage's estimate of $0.15 per share for the full year.
-- "We reiterate our attractive rating based on growth and this company's blue-chip status," it added.
-- It said Santista is the leader in Brazil's two highest-volume segments of the local food market, wheat and soy-based products.
-- As such, it "is a prime vehicle for participating in the long-term modernization, consolidation and growth of the Brazilian food sector," the broker said.
-- Santista ended Friday at 2.08 reais on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
